A stupidly simple https://livestream.agentics.org site separate to the main site so that the team can quickly fix up the details of how to get on the Livestream or the Zoom link

Instructions for use are in the https://github.com/agenticsorg/livestream-pages/wiki

Below are two separate artifacts:

Agentics shared branding files — intended to live on agentics.org

GitHub Pages livestream page — consumes the branding file but is independent

This separation keeps branding controlled by the site owner while letting GitHub Pages reuse it.
